☠️ PGFX LTX IN-CONTEXT PIPELINE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Multi-Stage Video Generation with In-Context Guidance — The flagshipsampler with full guide cascade

PIPELINE STAGES:
① PREP: PGFX_LTXVCorrectiveMask ensures the noise_mask is valid for LTX models
② INPUT: guiding_latents (IC-LoRA) + optional conditioning images → PGFX_LTXVInContextSampler
③ STAGE 1 (keyframe-only): fast pass to establish motion layout
④ STAGE 2 (full guide): expensive conditioning with guiding latents + optional image keyframes
⑤ STAGE 3 (keyframe-only): final refinement pass
⑥ CROP: PGFX_LTXVLatentUpsampler + standard VAE decode

FIXES APPLIED (2026-06-03):
→ pre_filter_count now matches SymmetricPatchifier(1, start_end=True) grid_mask
→ VisualInstruct JSON now includes 'action' key for motion description
→ guide_mask properly passed through append_keyframe for dilated latents
→ NestedTensor (AV model) support with _split/_merge video latent

Connect these standard ComfyUI nodes to the sampler inputs:
• VAE: from your LTX model checkpoint
• GUIDER: STGGuiderAdvanced
• SAMPLER: any LTX-compatible sampler
• SIGMAS: from your scheduler
• NOISE: from your noise source

PRE-FLIGHT: PGFX_LTXVCorrectiveMask
→ Ensures noise_mask exists and is correctly shaped
→ Critical for LTX models (prevents 'NoneType' errors in SamplerCustomAdvanced)
→ Set force_mask=false to only fix if broken

Connect your LTX VAE-produced latent here first.

UPSCALER: PGFX_LTXVLatentUpsampler
→ Preserves and spatially upscales noise_mask
→ Handles NestedTensor AV latents
→ Default: nearest-exact, 1x (passthrough)
→ Set scale_factor >1 for higher resolution

Bypass if no spatial upscaling is needed.

SAMPLER PARAMETERS GUIDE:

Guiding Latents (IC-LoRA): Your primary style/content reference
Optional Cond Images: Set indices via 'optional_cond_indices' string e.g. "0,8,16"
guiding_strength: 1.0 = full guide, lower = blend with base model
guiding_start_step: which denoising step to begin full guide
guiding_end_step: 1 = early termination for speed; raise for quality
max_guiding_latent_frames: 0 = all frames; cap to reduce VRAM
cond_image_strength: weight of optional keyframe images

STAGE-OPTIMIZED DENOISING

STAGE 1 (keyframe-only):
→ Sigma range: high_sigmas (start → guiding_start_step)
→ Only keyframes established, no guide conditioning
→ Very fast

STAGE 2 (full guide):
→ Sigma range: middle_sigmas (guiding_start_step → guiding_end_step)
→ Full guide conditioning + optional images applied
→ Most expensive step
→ Positive/negative conditioning outputs available

STAGE 3 (keyframe-only + crop):
→ Sigma range: low_sigmas (guiding_end_step → end)
→ Guide conditioning cropped away
→ Final clean pass

OUTPUTS: denoised_video (LATENT), positive (CONDITIONING), negative (CONDITIONING)
